label: If c, distinct from x, causes x's being r, then c efficiently causes x in respect r
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge: if c, distinct from x, causes x's being r (CausesIn), then c efficiently causes x in respect r (EfficientlyCausesIn). It relates two relations DISAMB-CAUSE keeps apart and does not identify them; it fails if perfection-causing includes exemplar or final causing that is not efficient.
